explanations.1: FilesMatch uses a regex pattern (the part in parentheses with backslashes) to match specific filenames; the pipe symbol | means 'or', so this targets file_1.gif OR file_2.png.
explanations.2: Order Allow,Deny sets up Apache's access control logic: it processes Allow rules first, then Deny rules, and denies by default if no Allow rule matches.
explanations.3: Deny from all blocks access to these files from every IP address, effectively making them inaccessible to anyone visiting your website.
